title: Arduino C++ subset interpreter

implements.text: Hand-written lexer, parser, type checker and closure-tree executor; generator statements so delay() can suspend
89 built-in functions: pin I/O, analog, timing, math, bits, strings, random, interrupts, ESP32 LEDC/DAC/touch/deep sleep
Serial, String, Wire (I2C), Servo, AccelStepper, Adafruit_NeoPixel, Adafruit_SSD1306, Adafruit_PWMServoDriver, LiquidCrystal(_I2C), MPU6050, QTRSensors, WiFi, WebServer, ArduinoLEDMatrix, ESP
Integer widths from the board profile (int wraps at 16 bits on Uno, 32 on ESP32)

mocked.text: Wi-Fi scan and connect with a fixed 1.2 s DHCP and a fake web table
SPI is a stub: transfer returns 0 (to be replaced by section 9)

unsupported.text: class, template, typedef, goto, try, new/delete, range-for, default arguments, struct methods, pointers other than const char*, #if/#ifdef, overloading
Registers (TCCR1A, PORTB), timers, SRAM size, ISR latency, EEPROM, SoftwareSerial, DHT, HTTPClient, OneWire
Cycle timing: every statement costs the same fixed time

parameterSources.note: real digitalWrite about 3.4 to 4 us (forum measurements)

validation.dataset: 189 vitest cases; 102 of 102 lesson references pass

errorMetrics.name: toggle period vs avr8js
errorMetrics.condition: blink, after 8 s; interpreter charges no time per statement

errorMetrics.name: serial line time drift vs avr8js

operatingRange.evidence: sketches inside the subset; 10 of 17 probe sketches compiled

knownFailureCases: Loop timing is about 2 times too fast for tight digitalWrite loops (estimated)
Idle skip jumps virtual time when an iteration has no visible effect
Pin edge trace silently truncates at 20,000 edges
Memory bombs abort the process (no heap cap)

performance.metric: statements per second, Uno busy loop
performance.machine: Apple silicon Mac, Node, shared load
performance.label: MEASURED
